aToB.memory: Rhea keeps her guard smoothly raised in Potions Class ever since Prof. Marlowe smiled faintly and asked whether Earth aluminum cans always retain a shadow-fold hum. Knowing Evelyn can read planar residue across a laboratory makes Rhea doubly cautious with her satchel—and leaves her deeply intrigued by why Evelyn personally championed Leo Vance's anomalous Earth transfer.
aToB.nextConversationGoal: Rhea wants to hand in a clean Potions Class assay while staying coolly unreadable, watching closely for any slip that reveals why Prof. Marlowe cares so much about Earth spatial signatures.

bToA.memory: Evelyn caught the faint dimensional static clinging to Rhea Nocturne's imported Earth trinkets almost immediately, though she has deliberately avoided filing a formal disciplinary report. Watching an enterprising senior nudge micro-seams around campus wards provides Evelyn useful background data—provided Rhea keeps her hobby confined to harmless ramen and cassette tapes.
bToA.nextConversationGoal: Evelyn wants to drop one deceptively casual Dimensional Theory remark near Rhea in the Potions & Alchemy Lab to gauge whether Rhea's smuggling network noticed any unusual Waystone resonance around Leo Vance's arrival.
